title: Pending Withdrawal Queued Until Trade Close
precondition: Sub-account configured with 'Queue Withdrawals Until Zero Positions' policy.
steps: 1. Investor requests withdrawal while trade active.
expected: Request registered as 'Pending_Trade_Close'; automatically executed the moment manager closes all positions.
coverage_note: Requires investor payment/withdrawal, lockup, reversal, or emergency LPOA workflow. Admin Set balance is not a substitute.
